name: Dragon Endeavour (Crew-2)
about: Dragon Endeavour (Crew-2) (2021-030A), a crewed vehicle (Dragon 2), launched 2021 Apr 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Apr 24), held fixed
docked to A08583; it stays docked here until it lands; the undocking is folded into the landing (a fudge of hours)
the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate); the point stands in for the programme's usual recovery area, from memory

events.why: the landing time is GCAT's end of mission (psatcat TDate)
